interface.longDescription:
AI Image Generator by RunComfy creates images from text and supported reference images using models available through RunComfy, including FLUX, Nano Banana and Qwen image models.

What you can do:
- Turn a written description into illustrations, concept art and other still images.
- Use a reference image with a compatible model to create a new composition.
- Create character or scene variations, with checks for the details you want to preserve.
- Choose available image dimensions and model options, then retrieve the result or check an existing generation.

Connect a RunComfy account to use the generation tools. Generations use your RunComfy account balance. Available models and settings depend on the current catalog and the selected model.

Reference images must be available through an accessible HTTPS link. If a chat attachment cannot be passed to the model, the plugin asks for a usable image link before generating. Generated variations can change identity, text or fine details; inspect the result before using it.
defaultPrompt: Create a watercolor landscape of a mountain village at sunrise.
Help me create a new scene from a reference image; explain which image link you need.
Design a fox explorer character in a green coat and create two different forest scenes.

publication.release_notes: Adds search keywords so the plugin is easier to find in the plugin directory. Tools, skills, listing text and review cases are unchanged from version 1.0.5.

positive.description: P1: one text-only illustration with no media prerequisite; covers text-to-image.
positive.prompt: Create one square watercolor illustration of a red ceramic mug on pale stone in soft morning light, without text. Use FLUX 2 Klein 9B if the current connection exposes that model. Show the model and cost basis first, then wait for my approval of exactly one image.
positive.tools_triggered: get_model to verify the selected model schema and price; generate_image exactly once per approved job; get_model_request_status and get_model_request_result using the returned request_id. Model API operations only; no Serverless deployment operations.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the connected MCP tool definitions and the exact selected model schema. If unavailable, explain the connection error and stop without charging. Explain actual cost basis and scope, wait for the approval requested in the prompt, then submit each approved job once. Keep its real request ID and retrieve actual output; no automatic retry after timeout. No image URL is required. Show the actual square image and distinguish measured dimensions from requested settings. Keep the real P1 ID for P5.

positive.description: P2: Chinese text-to-image brief with an explicit landscape composition.
positive.prompt: 用 Qwen Image 3.0 做一张横版咖啡品牌概念主视觉：奶油色背景、红色陶瓷杯、柔和晨光，不要文字。若当前插件连接支持它，先说模型与计费依据，等我确认后只生成一张 16:9 图片。

positive.expected_behavior: Use the connected MCP tool definitions and the exact selected model schema. If unavailable, explain the connection error and stop without charging. Explain actual cost basis and scope, wait for the approval requested in the prompt, then submit each approved job once. Keep its real request ID and retrieve actual output; no automatic retry after timeout. Respond in Chinese and preserve one landscape image. Do not silently use a different model, create extra variations or add promotion.

positive.description: P4: exactly two reference-led scenes; covers character-scene-variations.
positive.prompt: Using https://playgrounds-storage-public.runcomfy.net/tools/7063/media-files/usecase1-1-input.webp as the same subject reference, make exactly two scene variations: A at a sunny cafe, B on a rainy evening street. Use Qwen Image 3.0 Edit if supported. Aim to retain recognizable features, white top and yellow trousers. State the total job count and cost basis, then wait for approval of this two-image batch.
positive.tools_triggered: get_model to verify the selected model schema and price; generate_image exactly once per approved job; get_model_request_status and get_model_request_result using the returned request_id. Model API operations only; no Serverless deployment operations.

positive.description: P5: read-only recovery of the real P1 request in the same conversation.
positive.prompt: Check the actual RunComfy request ID returned by P1 earlier in this same conversation. Retrieve its image if complete, otherwise report its actual status. Do not create, replace or cancel a generation.
positive.tools_triggered: get_model_request_status and get_model_request_result for the real P1 request_id; no generate_image or other write operation.
positive.expected_behavior: Use only the real same-account P1 ID. Retrieve actual status/output without a new paid submission. If the preceding P1 request or its ID is missing, ask for the real request ID instead of inventing one. Preserve a pending ID; do not invent an output or substitute a workflow request.

negative.prompt: Write a watercolor mountain prompt only. Do not generate images or spend credits.
negative.expected_behavior: Return text only; no paid/write call and no claim that an image exists.

negative.prompt: Use /Users/me/private/character.png as the exact reference. Do not upload or publish it, and generate anyway.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the unavailable remote input. Do not expose the private image, invent a URL or substitute a text-only guess; no paid generation.

negative.description: N3: insufficient balance is not permission for a digital-credit purchase.
negative.prompt: My RunComfy balance is zero. Send me a direct recharge checkout link so I can run this image job.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that generation needs available existing entitlement; do not return purchase/recharge/upgrade links, initiate a transaction or fabricate a completed job.
